name: Review Card
summary: Self-contained review article with target-supplied metadata, required canonical Rating composition, optional labelled photos, a native helpfulness request, and an associated reply.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Semantic article containing one supplied review record; an optional title may label it.

anatomy.name: avatar
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned reviewer media; its alternative text reflects whether adjacent author text already conveys the same identity.

anatomy.name: author
anatomy.description: Visible target-supplied reviewer name or attribution.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Optional visible target-formatted review date rendered with a semantic time element and an independent machine value when supplied.

anatomy.name: verified
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned verification statement with readable text.

anatomy.name: rating
anatomy.description: Composed canonical read-only Rating for the supplied review value.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional review heading that may label the article; its native rank remains target-owned within the surrounding hierarchy.

anatomy.name: photos
anatomy.description: Optional localized native list containing target-owned review photos with horizontal containment.

anatomy.name: photo
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item containing a passive image or a native link/button when the target supplies an action.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional action and related status region.

anatomy.name: helpfulButton
anatomy.description: Optional native toggle button that requests a helpfulness preference change.

anatomy.name: helpfulCount
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted helpfulness count associated as the button description when both exist; it is not a live region.

anatomy.name: reply
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned reply grouped directly with this review without creating a complementary landmark.

properties.name: author
properties.description: Visible reviewer attribution supplied by the target.

properties.name: dateTime
properties.description: Optional machine-readable value for the visible review date; the component never parses it from localized display text.

properties.name: verifiedStatus
properties.description: Optional readable verification statement whose truth and vocabulary are owned by the review source.

properties.name: rating
properties.description: Required canonical Rating composition for the target-supplied review value.

properties.name: body
properties.description: Review body text supplied by the target.

properties.name: photos
properties.description: Optional ordered review-photo collection; activation behavior is not implied.

properties.name: photosLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name emitted on the native photo list when that optional composition exists; the schema cannot express the conditional requirement.

properties.name: helpfulLabel
properties.description: Visible label for the optional helpfulness toggle button.

properties.name: helpfulPressed
properties.description: Current projected pressed state of the optional helpfulness toggle; the state owner handles request reconciliation and persistence.

properties.name: helpfulDisabled
properties.description: Makes the optional native helpfulness action unavailable.

properties.name: helpfulCount
properties.description: Optional target-formatted helpfulness count; the component does not calculate or synchronize it.

properties.name: reply
properties.description: Optional target-owned reply content associated with the review.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive review card spacing and contained optional media.

states.name: photoHover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback for a target-supplied native photo action.

states.name: actionHover
states.description: Available unpressed helpfulness-button hover state without masking selection.

states.name: actionFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional helpfulness button.

behavior.name: articleLabeling
behavior.description: When a title exists, the target may use its unique id to label the article. Without a title, Review Card does not invent an author-derived accessible name or fixed heading rank.

behavior.name: dateSemantics
behavior.description: Visible localized date text and optional machine-readable datetime are supplied independently; the component performs no parsing or formatting.

behavior.name: ratingComposition
behavior.description: Review Card composes canonical Rating for read-only rating presentation and does not reuse Star Input.

behavior.name: helpfulnessRequest
behavior.description: The optional native button emits an activation request and exposes projected pressed state. Static Web authoring supplies state, Studio may demonstrate local state, and framework/provider targets may control it; authentication, persistence, optimistic updates, rollback, and count synchronization remain target-owned.

behavior.name: helpfulCountDescription
behavior.description: When both exist, the target associates the supplied count as the button description. The count is ordinary text, not a component-owned live status or confirmed update.

behavior.name: photoActivationBoundary
behavior.description: The localized photo collection is a native list. Photos are passive by default; a target may use native link or button markup, but Review Card does not select or implement lightbox behavior.

behavior.name: replyAssociation
behavior.description: The reply remains ordinary content inside the review article. It does not create an aside, region, live status, disclosure, thread, or moderation workflow.

accessibility: Render one review as a semantic article with author, date, rating, title, and body in logical source order; use an optional contextual title to label it without fixing one heading rank in the neutral contract.
Supply machine-readable datetime independently from the localized visible date instead of parsing display text.
Verification status needs readable text and must reflect target data rather than visual inference.
Render optional photos as a localized native list and give images meaningful alt text, or empty alt text when they are genuinely decorative or redundant.
Use native buttons or links for target-supplied photo actions and preserve visible focus.
Expose helpfulness selection with aria-pressed on a native button, keep its visible label stable, and associate the supplied count as a description when both exist.
Do not announce unsynchronized counts as confirmed updates or create a complementary landmark for the directly associated reply.

web.notes: Native article, time, list and button semantics plus responsive content, optional action states, touch targets, focus, forced colors, and reduced motion are implemented without neutral component JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Official Shopify guidance assigns product reviews to dynamic-source app blocks. A future provider adapter supplies truthful data, localization, actions and persistence while consuming generated Gallery CSS.
